title: pyrethrum tatsienense var. tanacetopsis
intro: Pyrethrum tatsienense var. tanacetopsis, commonly known as Chinese Chrysanthemum or Chrysanthemum tatsienense, is a plant species in the Asteraceae family. It has been used in traditional Chinese medicine for its medicinal properties and is known to possess health benefits, such as anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties, which can aid in wound healing and the treatment of various skin conditions. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its ability to calm the nervous system, reduce fever, and alleviate symptoms associated with respiratory issues like bronchitis and coughs. The bioactive constituents of Pyrethrum tatsienense var. tanacetopsis include flavonoids, saponins, and sesquiterpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
